title: Local History
description: Learn about local history (town history, famous citizens, historical events), talk to a local historian or museum staff.
required_interactions: Greeting a museum guide or local historian
Asking about the origins of the town
Inquiring about a famous historical figure from the area
Asking for the story behind a local monument or building
common_problems: Using modern terms for historical concepts
Not knowing the appropriate level of formality when speaking to a guide
learner_goals: Understand the basic timeline of the town's history
Identify and describe a famous local person
Ask polite questions about historical events
Describe a historical landmark using simple Italian
